name: Week 6 lab exercise - T1053.005 Scheduled Task
description: Techniques touched by the benign Week 6 lab exercise. Score = expected visibility in my lab (2 = logged today, 1 = needs a logging change, 0 = not visible).

techniques.comment: Method A: schtasks.exe /Create /SC MINUTE /MO 1; Method B: Register-ScheduledTask. Task runs a harmless logging .cmd from C:\Users\Public, then is deleted. Expected telemetry: 4688 schtasks.exe / powershell.exe; 4698 task created; 4699 task deleted; TaskScheduler/Operational 106, 200, 201, 141; 4688 cmd.exe with parent svchost.exe

Method A: schtasks.exe /Create /SC MINUTE /MO 1; Method B: Register-ScheduledTask. Task runs a harmless logging .cmd from C:\Users\Public, then is deleted. Expected telemetry: 4688 schtasks.exe / powershell.exe; 4698 task created; 4699 task deleted; TaskScheduler/Operational 106, 200, 201, 141; 4688 cmd.exe with parent svchost.exe

Method A: schtasks.exe /Create /SC MINUTE /MO 1; Method B: Register-ScheduledTask. Task runs a harmless logging .cmd from C:\Users\Public, then is deleted. Expected telemetry: 4688 schtasks.exe / powershell.exe; 4698 task created; 4699 task deleted; TaskScheduler/Operational 106, 200, 201, 141; 4688 cmd.exe with parent svchost.exe
Method B creates the task with PowerShell cmdlets (no schtasks.exe process). Expected telemetry: 4688 powershell.exe; PowerShell/Operational 4104 script block with Register-ScheduledTask
The task's action runs cmd.exe /c <logging .cmd> every minute. Expected telemetry: 4688 cmd.exe, parent svchost.exe (Schedule service), command line with the .cmd path
